Hazard: HAZ-DCK-001 Rotor start while UAV is retained or a person is at the dock
Worst credible mishap: Laceration or eye injury to maintainer or pilot; damage to dock
Causal factors (full text in CSV): CF1 (software) Arming check or dock interlock permits arming while retained; CF2 (human) Maintainer arms the aircraft on the dock outside procedure; CF3 (interface) Charging handshake energises propulsion (IF-PX4-009)
Initial Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design); rotor strike can cause permanent partial disability; dock operations are frequent.
Target Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design); hardware rotor-power interlock independent of PX4 arming.

Hazard: HAZ-DCK-002 False retained state releases UAV under motion
Worst credible mishap: UAV strikes pilot, crew or bystander; aircraft damaged
Causal factors (full text in CSV): CF1 (software) Retention state fusion reports retained with latch open; CF2 (hardware) Latch sensor failure or latch wear; CF3 (environment) Vibration during walking unseats a partially latched aircraft
Initial Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design); compact UAV falling from height can seriously injure a person nearby.
Target Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design); independent latch sensing and fail-closed latch design.

Hazard: HAZ-INT-001 UAV launch or recovery outside the safe envelope
Worst credible mishap: Rotor or airframe strike injuring pilot or crew
Causal factors (full text in CSV): CF1 (software) Integration manager grants a launch/recovery permit on stale or inconsistent state; CF2 (interface) Lost integration link during approach (IF-PX4-006); CF3 (environment) Gusts near the walker structure during recovery; CF4 (software) A PX4 failsafe (return-to-launch on link loss or low battery) flies a recovery to the dock with no integration manager permit; in SITL it descended 1.9 m from the pilot station (simulation SU-01; synthetic); CF5 (interface) PX4 home stays at the take-off point after the walker moves, so a return lands where the dock used to be, possibly among the ground crew (simulation SU-02; synthetic); CF6 (software) The integration manager trusts PX4's reported position (IF-PX4-001) without validity checks; under GPS loss the estimate was 170 m wrong (simulation SU-06; synthetic)
Initial Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design); recovery near an occupied station is a frequent, demanding operation.
Mitigations (precedence): M1(a) M2(c) M3(c) M4(c) M5(c) M6(c) M7(c)
Target Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design); envelope inhibit, independent permit and verified abort behaviour.

Hazard: HAZ-MAN-001 Person struck or pinned by the arms or claws
Worst credible mishap: Fatal or disabling crush or impact injury to a person near the walker
Causal factors (full text in CSV): CF1 (human) Person inside the exclusion zone or the arms' reach (crew, observer or bystander); CF2 (hardware) Arms not stowed and locked while walking: in the CL-05 layout the hanging claws reach 0.85 m above the ground beside the legs, inside the walking envelope; CF3 (software) Manipulation commanded or not inhibited while walking or while the exclusion zone is not confirmed clear
Initial Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design; AI-drafted, I0, for the safety lead to rate); multi-tonne arms with claws; crew work close to the walker on every sortie
Target Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design; AI-drafted, I0, for the safety lead to rate); arm stow interlock for walking, manipulation inhibit without a confirmed clear zone, and the exclusion zone

Hazard: HAZ-MAN-002 Carried load swings, shifts or drops while walking
Worst credible mishap: Fatal or disabling injury to a person struck by the load, or to the pilot in a resulting fall
Causal factors (full text in CSV): CF1 (environment) Inertial loads from the gait, slope or uneven ground act on the load; CF2 (hardware) Grip or securing failure, or the arms leave the carry pose; CF3 (human) Load mass, centre of gravity, speed, step height or slope beyond the loaded limits; CF4 (software) Loaded walking enabled without confirmed securing, carry pose and load limits
Initial Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design; AI-drafted, I0, for the safety lead to rate); a dropped or swinging load from a 4.5 m walker can strike people or upset the walker
Target Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design; AI-drafted, I0, for the safety lead to rate); loaded-walking limits and interlocks reduce but are not expected to remove load motion while walking

Hazard: HAZ-PIL-001 Unintended leg motion during pilot ingress or egress
Worst credible mishap: Crush or fall injury to pilot or ground crew during ingress/egress
Causal factors (full text in CSV): CF1 (software) Motion-enable logic enables actuation before readiness conditions are met; CF2 (hardware) Valve or drive fault produces motion with enable removed; CF3 (human) Pilot inadvertently deflects a control while entering
Initial Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design); crush between multi-tonne structure can be fatal; ingress occurs every sortie.
Target Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design); independent hardware enable chain plus supported posture make occurrence improbable.

Hazard: HAZ-PIL-002 Uncontrolled vertical drop of the cockpit on loss of leg support
Worst credible mishap: Spinal compression, head or neck injury to the restrained pilot
Causal factors (full text in CSV): CF1 (hardware) Loss of actuator supply (hydraulic line burst or bus loss) together with load-holding valves or brakes that fail to engage (latent failure); CF2 (hardware) Load holding engages, but slower than the cockpit falls from operating height (engagement delay longer than the free-fall time)
Initial Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary, drafted from failure search SF-01 edge cases EC-01 to EC-06 (synthetic, no evidence credit). A drop of about 1.2 m onto rest stops can cause permanent partial disability; supply loss is credible over the item life and nothing yet prevents the fall.
Target Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary; fail-safe load holding that needs no signal or supply to engage, plus an energy-absorbing seat, makes the uncontrolled drop improbable.

Hazard: HAZ-PIL-003 Fall from height during emergency egress
Worst credible mishap: Fatal or disabling fall injury to the pilot
Causal factors (full text in CSV): CF1 (human) Hurried descent, darkness, smoke or injury during emergency egress; CF2 (hardware) Descent aid not deployed, out of reach, or the step-to-ladder transfer is missed; CF3 (environment) Walker leaning or on a slope, wet or icy surfaces
Initial Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design; AI-drafted, I0, for the safety lead to rate); emergency egress is rare, but a 3.2 m fall can be fatal
Target Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design; AI-drafted, I0, for the safety lead to rate); descent aid, shoulder step with handholds and fall-arrest provision

Hazard: HAZ-PWR-001 Residual hydraulic pressure during maintenance
Worst credible mishap: Crush or fluid-injection injury to maintainer
Causal factors (full text in CSV): CF1 (hardware) Accumulator or trapped volume not vented by isolation; CF2 (human) Maintainer skips isolation or verification step
Initial Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design); hydraulic injection and crush injuries can be fatal; maintenance is periodic.
Target Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design); lockable isolation with gauge-verified zero energy and mechanical supports.

Hazard: HAZ-PWR-002 Battery thermal runaway near the pilot station
Worst credible mishap: Burn or inhalation injury to the pilot or a maintainer; loss of the walker
Causal factors (full text in CSV): CF1 (hardware) Internal cell short, over-charge or over-temperature not detected or not isolated by the BMS; CF2 (environment) Mechanical damage to the pack in a fall or overturn (SCN-103); CF3 (human) Damaged or wet pack charged or returned to service without inspection
Initial Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design, no cell chemistry selected); a pack fire beside an occupied cockpit can be fatal; runaway is remote for a managed pack.
Target Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design); pack separated from the cockpit by a fire barrier and vented away from it, independent BMS isolation, and emergency egress.

Hazard: HAZ-PWR-003 Fuel leak and fire at the engine-generator
Worst credible mishap: Burn injury to the pilot, a maintainer or ground crew
Causal factors (full text in CSV): CF1 (hardware) Fuel line, fitting or tank failure from vibration or a fall (SCN-103); CF2 (human) Refuelling with the engine hot or running, or near an ignition source; CF3 (hardware) Exhaust or engine surface hotter than the fuel's autoignition temperature next to a leak path
Initial Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design, no fuel selected); a fuel fire beside an occupied cockpit can be fatal; leaks are remote for a protected fuel system.
Target Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design); separated and shielded fuel system, fuel shut-off on protective stop, and a refuelling procedure.

Hazard: HAZ-SAF-001 Protective stop does not reach a safe state
Worst credible mishap: Fall, crush or impact injury to pilot or bystanders
Causal factors (full text in CSV): CF1 (software) Stop supervisor commands an unsafe trajectory or zero torque in a loaded pose; CF2 (hardware) Loss of hydraulic or electrical power during the stop; CF3 (interface) Stop request not received over the pilot or observer link
Initial Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design); no stop architecture exists; collapse with pilot aboard can be fatal.
Target Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design); mode-specific stop with mechanical load holding and independent stop path.

Hazard: HAZ-WLK-001 Stale or lost feedback causes runaway motion
Worst credible mishap: Walker fall or limb strike injuring pilot or bystanders
Causal factors (full text in CSV): CF1 (hardware) Sensor, connector or bus failure; CF2 (software) Monitor fails to detect stale data or detection is too slow; CF3 (software) Locomotion controller acts on stale state
Initial Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design); feedback loss is a common failure class; consequence includes fall with pilot.
Target Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design); redundant sensing, staleness monitor and mechanical joint limits.

Hazard: HAZ-WLK-002 Walker tip-over or fall with pilot aboard
Worst credible mishap: Pilot fatal or disabling injury in fall; crush of bystanders
Causal factors (full text in CSV): CF1 (software) Balance controller fails to recover or commands an unstable gait; CF2 (environment) Terrain gives way or slope exceeds envelope; CF3 (human) Pilot commands manoeuvre or payload beyond limits; CF4 (hardware) Loss of actuator supply (hydraulic pressure or bus voltage) shrinks the balance capacity before load holding engages; a slow leak on a slope tips the walker, and a hold that engages with the capture point outside the foot tips it too (simulation SF-01 EC-07 and EC-08 at level 1; at level 2 with the adopted torques EC-07 drops the cockpit instead and EC-08 tips only with the ankle at or below about 12 kN m; sizing SZ-01; synthetic)
Initial Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design); legged platforms have frequent balance-loss events during development.
Mitigations (precedence): M1(b) M2(c) M3(c) M4(d) M5(c) M6(b) M7(c)
Target Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design); envelope limiting, rollover protection and restraint.

Hazard: HAZ-WLK-003 Crushing under the pod or legs while kneeling or rising
Causal factors (full text in CSV): CF1 (human) Crew member or bystander inside the folding zone of the pod and legs; CF2 (software) Kneel or rise commanded without a confirmed clear zone; CF3 (hardware) Uncontrolled descent while lowering (loss of actuator supply or load holding)
Initial Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design; AI-drafted, I0, for the safety lead to rate); the CL-05 pod drops about 1.4 m (hip 2.34 m to 0.95 m) on every ingress and egress
Target Risk · Basis (rationale): Preliminary qualitative judgement at concept stage (no design; AI-drafted, I0, for the safety lead to rate); clear-zone confirmation, controlled lowering speed and load holding
